Load data

gene_files <- list.files("/data/akalin/akollot/anglemania_benchmark/simulated/preprocessed", full.names = TRUE)
samplesheet <- read.csv("/local/Projects/AAkalin_Neuroblastoma/Results/simulate_single_cell/samplesheet_low_facLoc.tsv", sep = "\t")
find_matching_files <- function(sample_name, files) {
  matching_files <- grep(sample_name, files, value = TRUE)
  return(matching_files)
}

identify_gene_selections <- function(file_name) {
    if (grepl("_full.tsv", file_name)) {
        return("full")
    } else if (grepl("_hvg.tsv", file_name)) {
        return("hvg")
    } else if (grepl("_rand.tsv", file_name)) {
        return("rand")
    } else if (grepl("_angl.tsv", file_name)) {
        return("angl")
    }
}

expanded <- samplesheet %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(tsv_files = list(find_matching_files(sample_name, gene_files))) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(tsv_files) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(gene_selection = identify_gene_selections(tsv_files),
           gene_selection = factor(gene_selection, levels = c("full", "hvg", "rand", "angl"))) %>%
    ungroup()
outplot <- "/home/akollot/projects/CRC1588/dataset_integration/anglemania_benchmark/output/plots/compare_gene_selections"

Calculate BTVR

library(scales)
get_rowData <- function(sim_h5ad_path){
  df <- h5read(sim_h5ad_path, "/var") %>% as.data.frame() %>% column_to_rownames("X_index")
  return(df)
}

get_BTVR <- function(rowdata) {
  # Calculate BioVar and TechVar using vectorized operations
  bio_var_cols <- dplyr::select(rowdata, starts_with("DEFacGroup"))
  tech_var_cols <- dplyr::select(rowdata, starts_with("BatchFacBatch"))

  # Use apply function to compute variances row-wise
  raw_BioVar <- apply(bio_var_cols, 1, var)
  BioVar <- raw_BioVar
  BioVar[BioVar > 0] <- raw_BioVar[raw_BioVar > 0] %>%
    log() %>%
    rescale()
  raw_TechVar <- apply(tech_var_cols, 1, var)
  TechVar <- raw_TechVar %>%
    log() %>%
    rescale()

  # Compute BTVR directly
  BTVR <- BioVar / TechVar
  GeneScore <- BTVR * BioVar #basically "scaled" by BioVar

  # Create result tibble
  summary_df <- tibble(
    gene = rownames(rowdata),
    BTVR = BTVR,
    GeneScore = GeneScore,
    raw_BioVar = raw_BioVar,
    BioVar = BioVar,
    raw_TechVar = raw_TechVar,
    TechVar = TechVar,
    GeneMean = rowdata$GeneMean
  )

  return(summary_df)
}

get_BTVR2 <- function(rowdata) {
  # 1. Identify columns for biology and technical factors
  bio_var_cols <- dplyr::select(rowdata, starts_with("DEFacGroup"))
  tech_var_cols <- dplyr::select(rowdata, starts_with("BatchFacBatch"))

  # 2. Compute row-wise variance
  bio_var <- apply(bio_var_cols, 1, var)
  tech_var <- apply(tech_var_cols, 1, var)

  # 3. Total variance (ignoring interaction)
  total_var <- bio_var + tech_var

  # 4. Fractions of total variance
  bio_frac <- bio_var / total_var
  tech_frac <- tech_var / total_var
  BioVar <- bio_var
  BioVar[BioVar > 0] <- log(BioVar[BioVar > 0])
  BioVar <- BioVar %>% rescale()
  TechVar <- tech_var %>% log() %>% rescale()
  # Compute BTVR directly
  BTVR <- BioVar/TechVar
  # If total_var = 0 for some genes (e.g., all factors = 1), these become NaN;
  # you could set them to 0 or handle them as you like.
  # Create result tibble
  summary_df <- tibble(
    gene = rownames(rowdata),
    BioVar = bio_var,
    TechVar = tech_var,
    TotalVar = total_var,
    BioFrac = bio_frac,   # fraction of total variance that is biological
    TechFrac = tech_frac,
    BTVR = BTVR
  )

  return(summary_df)
}
btvr <- expanded %>%
  filter(gene_selection %in% c("hvg", "angl")) %>%
  group_by(sample_name) %>%
  mutate(group_size = n()) %>%
         filter(group_size > 1) %>% # make sure to only include the samples that have both the angl and hvg genes already calculated (snakemake pipeline preprocess)
  pivot_wider(names_from = gene_selection, values_from = tsv_files)

# construct nested tibble but don't use tidyverse cause it's freaking slow
rowdatas <- pblapply(btvr$original_h5ad, get_rowData, cl = 20)
h5closeAll()
BTVR <- pblapply(rowdatas, get_BTVR, cl = 20)
angl <- pblapply(btvr$angl, function(x) {
  genes <- read.csv(x, sep = "\t", header = T) %>% pull(hgnc_symbol)
  }, cl = 20)
hvg <- pblapply(btvr$hvg, function(x) {
  genes <- read.csv(x, sep = "\t", header = T) %>% pull(hgnc_symbol)
  }, cl = 20)
btvr$BTVR <- BTVR
btvr$angl <- angl
btvr$hvg <- hvg

btvr_raw <- btvr
btvr <- btvr_raw %>% 
  mutate(btvr_dist = pmap(
list(angl, hvg, BTVR),
      ~ { genes <- unique(c(..1, ..2))
        # Create a tibble for genes with their BTVR values
        merged_tbl <- ..3 %>%
          dplyr::filter(gene %in% genes) %>%
          mutate(
            angl = gene %in% ..1,
            hvg = gene %in% ..2
          )
        # Return the new tibble
        merged_tbl} )) 

btvr <- btvr %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(btvr_dist = list(btvr_dist %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(angl, hvg), 
    names_to = "gene_selection", 
    values_to = "is_selected") %>% filter(is_selected)))

for (i in 1:10){
  plot_df <- btvr[i, ]
  # print(plot_df)
  # print(plot_df$btvr_dist)
  print(plot_df$btvr_dist %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    ggplot(aes(gene_selection, BTVR))+
    geom_violin(aes(fill = gene_selection))+
    ggtitle(paste0("Bio to Technical variability ratio. de.facLoc: ", plot_df$de.facLoc, " batch.facLoc: ", plot_df$batch.facLoc)))
}

Unnest and summarize the BTVR over the different nbatch, and ngroup combinations

  • anglemania genes have a much higher BTVR (bio to technical variability) => this is great!
unnested <- btvr %>%
  select(-BTVR, -angl, -hvg) %>%
  unnest(btvr_dist) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.infinite(BTVR)) # there was one gene (!) that had 0 TechVar so BTVR was infinite, but really only 1 gene lol.
head(unnested)
# unnested %>%
#   ggplot()
unnested %>%
  distinct(ngroup, nbatch)
# Summarize the data and pivot to wide format
summary_df_BTVR <- unnested %>%
  group_by(gene_selection, batch.facLoc, de.facLoc) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(BTVR, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(BTVR, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(BTVR, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'  # Avoid unnecessary grouping
  )

Plotting

BTVR

Mean

# Plot heatmap
new_labels <- c("angl" = "anglemania genes", "hvg" = "highly variable genes")
size <- 1-6e-4
ggplot(summary_df_BTVR, aes(x = as.factor(batch.facLoc), y = as.factor(de.facLoc), fill = mean)) +
  geom_tile(width = size, height = size) +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~gene_selection, labeller = labeller(gene_selection = new_labels)) +  # Facet by gene_selection
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey", high = "purple") +
  # scale_fill_continuous(type = "viridis", limits = c(0, 1.1)) +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of MEAN BTVR by Batch and Biological Variability",
       x = "Strength of Technical Noise (batch.facLoc)",
       y = "Biological Variability (de.facLoc)",
       fill = "Mean BTVR") +
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 20)
    )

rawTechVar

  • However it still captures genes with high technical variability, just like HVGs, with increasing Technical Variability / Batch effects

Mean

summary_df_rawTechVar <- unnested %>%
  mutate(raw_TechVar = log(raw_TechVar)) %>%
  group_by(gene_selection, batch.facLoc, de.facLoc) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(raw_TechVar, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(raw_TechVar, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(raw_TechVar, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'  # Avoid unnecessary grouping
  )
